name: pm-sp
description: Light pm: Joe's personal layer on top of Agent Runway, which carries the shaping (grill, prototype, map and spec) and the hands-on skill (plans, subagents, TDD, debugging, verification). Runway itself is per repo: a repo not added to it never sees tickets or Runway suggestions, and one that is gets a single ask, kept as `runway: yes|no` in the spec. pm-sp adds the session layer (whats-next, stepping-away, checkpoint), the scaffold, design-handoff for screens first, second-opinion (Sol via Ringer plus a fresh Opus), ship-acceptance against production, the credential guard, gate-hooks, review-policy, ui-test, okf, granola-transcript, and four Matt Pocock skills Runway has nothing like (domain-modeling, codebase-design, research, pr). Requires the agent-runway plugin. An alternative to pm: install one or the other.
